## VSiN Stability Score — as printed

Steve Makinen's Stability Score (pp. 41–44), reproduced exactly. This library does not recompute it, re-weight it, or substitute a TTW score.

| Component | Points | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Head coach returns | 4 | Returning head coach |
| Offensive coordinator returns | 0 | **New OC** |
| Defensive coordinator returns | 0 | **New DC** |
| Quarterback returns | 4 | Returning QB |
| Returning starters | 2 | 10 returning starters as printed in the table |
| **Total** | **10** | 2025 record 5-7 |

> The guide's own use of this number: it plays on teams with a Stability Score edge of 6 or more in non-conference games in weeks 0–3, and against teams scoring 0–6 in the same window, excluding games with a spread of 30 or more (pp. 40–41).

## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 34. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke opens with the standard he thinks applies here: anybody who wins five games at Kent State deserves Coach of the Year consideration. He records the mechanism of the promotion — starting the season 3-5 meant Carney's interim tag was stripped off — and the baseline he inherited: the team was 0-16 in MAC play and 1-23 overall under Kenni Burns, so Carney's .500 record in the conference and 5-7 season was remarkable. He notes they fell short of bowl eligibility but beat rival Akron and also Bowling Green, then explains why the season totals look worse than the team was: losses of 62-14, 66-10 and 44-0 to Texas Tech, Florida State and Oklahoma in non-conference play. Otherwise, he writes, Carney's team was competitive most weeks and should be again this season.

## SOURCE CONFLICT

**new / returning head coach.** The guide states this three ways and they do not agree: the team page prints “Mark Carney - 2nd season”; the Stability Score table (p. 43) awards 4 points for a returning head coach, so it treats the position as unchanged; the Coaching Carousel feature (pp. 28–37) lists the programme. All three are reproduced as printed and none is corrected.
